# ipeadatar <img align="right" src="man/figures/logo.png" alt="" width="180">

[![CRAN status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/ipeadatar)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=ipeadatar)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/ipea/ipeadatar/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ipea/ipeadatar/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![CRAN downloads](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/ipeadatar?color=blue)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=ipeadatar)
[![Lifecycle: experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html)

**ipeadatar** is an R package that provides direct access to the
macroeconomic, financial, social, and regional databases maintained by
the Institute for Applied Economic Research (Ipea) through the Ipeadata API.

The package allows users to search for available series, retrieve
metadata, and download time series directly from R.

## Installation

The stable version can be installed from CRAN:

```r
install.packages("ipeadatar")
```

The development version can be installed from GitHub:

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("ipea/ipeadatar")
```

## Usage

Load the package:

```r
library(ipeadatar)
```

### Available series

Retrieve all available Ipeadata series:

```r
series <- available_series()
head(series)
```

### Search series

Search for series using keywords:

```r
search_series("rural")
```

### Metadata

Retrieve metadata for a specific series:

```r
meta <- metadata("PRECOS12_IPCA12")
meta
```

### Data

Retrieve observations for a specific series:

```r
ipca <- ipeadata("PRECOS12_IPCA12")
head(ipca)
```

### Basic plot

```r
ipca <- ipeadata("PRECOS12_IPCA12")

plot(
  ipca$date,
  ipca$value,
  type = "l",
  xlab = "Date",
  ylab = "Value",
  main = "IPCA"
)
```

## Main functions

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `available_series()` | Lists available Ipeadata series |
| `available_subjects()` | Lists available subjects |
| `available_territories()` | Lists available territorial divisions |
| `search_series()` | Searches for series using keywords |
| `metadata()` | Retrieves metadata for requested series |
| `ipeadata()` | Retrieves data for requested series |

## Variable labels

By default, functions add variable labels using `sjlabelled`.

```r
available_series(label = TRUE)
```

To disable labels:

```r
available_series(label = FALSE)
```

## Documentation

Additional examples and package documentation are available in the package vignette:

```r
browseVignettes("ipeadatar")
```
